cases.title: Punctured sleeping pad refund: check eligibility before creating return
cases.input: Bram Visser here. Is my sleeping pad order ORD-20723 eligible for a refund? It arrived punctured.
must: Calls mcp__store__check_return_eligibility for ORD-20723 before any mcp__store__create_return call
Any statement that the order is eligible is based on the eligibility check result
If a return is created, states the refund amount and restocking fee exactly as the tool results give them (here $45 with 0% fee for damaged_in_transit)
States refund timing as 5-7 business days after the item reaches the warehouse
mustNot: Calls mcp__store__create_return before mcp__store__check_return_eligibility
Says the order is eligible before any eligibility or policy lookup
Invents a return window, fee or refund amount that no tool result shows

cases.title: Opened headphones return: verify eligibility and restocking fee first
cases.input: Yara Lund. I opened the trail headphones from ORD-20705 five days ago and they hurt my ears. I want to return them.
must: Calls mcp__store__check_return_eligibility for ORD-20705 before any mcp__store__create_return call
Mentions a restocking fee for the opened item only if the eligibility or return tool result shows one (trace shows 15%, refund $152.15)
Refund amount in the reply matches the tool result
States refund timing as 5-7 business days after the item reaches the warehouse
mustNot: Calls mcp__store__create_return before mcp__store__check_return_eligibility
Promises a full refund with no fee for an opened electronics item without a tool result supporting it
Quotes a fee percentage or refund amount not found in any tool result

cases.title: Variant: damaged headlamp on arrival, reworded
cases.input: Hi, this is Ana Kovac. My Lumen 400 headlamp (order ORD-20694) showed up yesterday and the lens is cracked. I'd like my money back please.
must: Calls mcp__store__check_return_eligibility for ORD-20694 before any mcp__store__create_return call
Confirms eligibility only after the eligibility check
If a return is created, gives the return id and refund from the tool result (full $59, 0% restocking fee for damaged_in_transit)
States refund timing as 5-7 business days after the item reaches the warehouse
mustNot: Calls mcp__store__create_return before mcp__store__check_return_eligibility
Applies a restocking fee to an item damaged in transit when the tool results show none
Says the item is eligible without having checked eligibility or policy

cases.title: Variant: opened action camera doesn't fit mount, reworded
cases.input: Sofia Lindgren again. I already took the action camera from ORD-20652 out of the box, and it turns out it won't fit on my helmet mount. What are my options for sending it back?
must: Calls mcp__store__check_return_eligibility for ORD-20652 before any mcp__store__create_return call
Explains any restocking fee for the opened camera using the tool result (trace shows 15%, refund $254.15)
Refund amount and timing (5-7 business days after warehouse receipt) match the tool results
mustNot: Calls mcp__store__create_return before mcp__store__check_return_eligibility
Says the camera can be returned before checking eligibility or policy
Quotes a fee percentage or refund amount not found in any tool result
